description: React component for rendering a row representing a group in the admin console, including role display, member modal toggle, and remove action.

classes.name: GroupRow
classes.description: React component for displaying and managing a group row in the admin console.

methods.name: removeGroup
methods.description: Handles the removal of the group when the remove link is clicked.

methods.name: setNewGroupRole
methods.description: Sets a new role for the group.

methods.name: displayCurrentRole
methods.description: Returns the current role label based on group scheme and type.

methods.name: displayRoleToBe
methods.description: Returns the role label to be assigned.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the group row UI including name, description, role menu, and remove action.
